<<<SOLUTION_CODE>>>
const values = require('node:fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number);

let index = 0;
const t = values[index++] ?? 0;
const output = [];

for (let caseId = 0; caseId < t; caseId++) {
  const n = values[index++] ?? 0;
  const a = values.slice(index, index + n);
  index += n;

  let total = 0;
  for (const value of a) total += value;

  let prefix = 0;
  let ok = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    prefix += a[i];
    if (prefix * 2 === total) {
      ok = true;
      break;
    }
  }

  output.push(ok ? 'Yes' : 'No');
}

process.stdout.write(output.join('\n'));
<<<MAKER_TS>>>
import { defineDataset, fmt } from 'genesis-kit';

type TestCase = {
  n: number;
  a: number[];
};

type Input = {
  tests: TestCase[];
};

function isPositiveInt(value: number): boolean {
  return Number.isInteger(value) && value > 0;
}

function isPositiveIntArray(values: number[]): boolean {
  return values.every(isPositiveInt);
}

export default defineDataset<Input>({
  solution: 'std.js',
  seed: 'ai-regression-balanced-sequence',
  format: ({ tests }) => fmt.lines(
    [tests.length],
    ...tests.flatMap(({ n, a }) => [[n], a]),
  ),
  validate: ({ tests }) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(tests)) return 'tests must be an array';
    if (tests.length < 2 || tests.length > 100) return 't must be in [2, 100]';
    for (const [testIndex, test] of tests.entries()) {
      if (!isPositiveInt(test.n)) return `tests[${testIndex}].n must be a positive integer`;
      if (test.n < 3 || test.n > 10000) return `tests[${testIndex}].n must be in [3, 10000]`;
      if (!Array.isArray(test.a) || test.a.length !== test.n) return `tests[${testIndex}].a length mismatch`;
      if (!isPositiveIntArray(test.a)) return `tests[${testIndex}].a must contain positive integers`;
      if (test.a.some(value => value > 10000)) return `tests[${testIndex}].a values must be in [1, 10000]`;
    }
    return true;
  },
  cases: [
    {
      name: 'sample',
      tags: ['sample'],
      input: {
        tests: [
          { n: 3, a: [1, 2, 3] },
          { n: 4, a: [2, 3, 1, 4] },
          { n: 5, a: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] },
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      name: 'small-clear-mix',
      tags: ['small'],
      input: {
        tests: [
          { n: 3, a: [1, 1, 2] },
          { n: 4, a: [1, 1, 1, 1] },
          { n: 5, a: [2, 1, 1, 2, 2] },
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      name: 'late-split-and-no-split',
      tags: ['structure'],
      input: {
        tests: [
          { n: 5, a: [3, 1, 2, 1, 5] },
          { n: 6, a: [2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3] },
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      name: 'near-upper-values',
      tags: ['values'],
      input: {
        tests: [
          { n: 4, a: [10000, 10000, 10000, 10000] },
          { n: 3, a: [9999, 10000, 10000] },
        ],
      },
    },
    {
      name: 'generated-mixed',
      tags: ['generated'],
      repeat: 2,
      generate: ({ g }) => {
        const buildBalanced = (): TestCase => {
          const leftCount = g.int(1, 3);
          const rightCount = g.int(2, 4);
          const target = Math.max(leftCount, rightCount) + g.int(2, 20);
          const left = g.partition(leftCount, target);
          const right = g.partition(rightCount, target);
          return {
            n: left.length + right.length,
            a: [...left, ...right],
          };
        };

        const buildOddTotal = (): TestCase => {
          const n = g.int(3, 7);
          const a = g.array(n, () => g.int(1, 20));
          const sum = a.reduce((acc, value) => acc + value, 0);
          if (sum % 2 === 0) {
            a[0] = Math.min(10000, a[0] + 1);
          }
          return { n, a };
        };

        return {
          tests: [
            buildBalanced(),
            buildOddTotal(),
            buildBalanced(),
            buildOddTotal(),
          ],
        };
      },
    },
  ],
});
